BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Aranea!!
Sir Halios, are you alright?!\nHere I come...
Idiot... Don't... Don't come!!
Adventurer!! W-What's that?!
You looked closer at him...
Eerie light-emitting strings extended from the\nfour strange metal stakes are pulling his arms\nand legs with rasping sound...
Gu fa fa fa!\nHow do you like that?\nNow you wanna get out of my way, huh?
Heh!! I just wanted to stretch myself...\nActually... it's a good workout!
Gu fa fa fa! I'm glad you like it.\nBut why don't you stretch yourself more?\nTill you're torn limb from limb!!
Gargh! Ugg... Argh...
Nooo! Sir Halios!
Adventurer! Do something, please!!
You should just get out of my way...\nEven if you hold out here, you'll be torn apart\nand end up a feed for monsters. Gu fa fa!
T-That might be true... But if I made way,\nNoieverre would be defiled by you, a filthy\nmonster...
I'm often scolded for overlooking something\ntoo many times by Dunkelis but... Ugg... I can\nnever overlook evil monsters like you...
Idiot! Then, you shall be torn limb from limb!
Gah?! Agarrhh!! My body! My bodyyyy!\nI'm devoured! Help me! Help meeeee!!
Sir Halios!! Are you alright?!
Yea, I'm messed up though.\nThanks for saving me..\nHm? Who are you?
...Oh, yea?\nHow lucky to be saved by Grecia...
Why were you in such a situation...?
Well, when I parted from Zolban, I left for saving\nDunkelis but...
I encountered a group of monsters that were trying\nto enter Noieverre on my way...
Huh? What is Noieverre, you ask?\nNobody tells about Noieverre in your world?
Noieverre is a world of high dimension. Only the\nsouls of high class, which repeated rebirth many\ntimes, can enter. Keep it in your mind.
Though they are controlled by the crystals,\nit's a shame of Dark Troops to intrude into\nNoieverre.
I was trying to hold them back but the monsters\nand soldiers were increasing.
When I was struggling to deal with them,\nthe spider showed up and tied me up.\nShame on me... Meh.
What? ...Yea, I guess Dunkelis has reached the\nCradle of Soldiers.
You know, Vatendeth my brother is with her.\nSo, they should be trying to restore the Dark\nTroops.
You've seen it right? Seems like the black\ncrystals are growing by parasitizing other living\nthings.
So, even if she called up new soldiers and\nknights, they would be infested by the crystals\nand become our enemy...
Grecia asked you to go save Dunkelis, right?\nAs I said, my brother is supposed to protect her.
Please give him a hand...\nI'll prevent the black crystals from spreading\nto other places right here.
B-But are you alright? You're injured...
I'm a big brother of the Dark General, you know?\nI can hold out for a while!
But... Oh! Right. Sir Zolban was also injured\nbut he said he would be coming later...
I knew it. He was beaten.\nI would've said an injured man couldn't be of\nhelp. Well, actually it's kinda reassuring now.
Okay, don't worry about me. I'll leave all about\nDunkelis and Vatendeth to you.
A-Adventurer! Y-Y-Your hand!!
I heard you're a human, so I knew you're being\ndissolved.
Sorry, I'm not as strong as Grecia but it should\ndo for a while.
Ask Dunkelis to stop it when you see her.\nAlright, take care.
